description.value: The study investigated cortical thickness, cortical volume, and subcortical structure shape and volume in drug-naïve controls, low-exposure users, and experienced amphetamine-type stimulant users.

spans.text: Based on previous results it is hypothesized that subjects with little exposure to MDMA and amphetamine do not display any alterations of the cortical structure, whereas experienced users are assumed to exhibit cortical thinning and cortical volume reductions compared to drug-naïve controls and low exposure users.
